revisions.reason: Review 20261124 PR #33 rebased onto main d529dcfd7: attachDynamicOverlay gives a session disc or bare-EXE import a durable OPFS journal keyed by its fingerprint (media-import.js overlayScopeFor: disc:v1:<sha256 of the file listing> or exe:v1:<sha256 of the EXE bytes>), with the same checkpoint and stop flush kept imports already use; imports with no fingerprint log once and keep the memory store. Replaces the PR's two earlier reviews (disc-id-session-saves-20261121, bare-exe-session-saves-20261124), which anchored before main's manifest-space-free review. No scheduler, renderer or callback lifetime change. Covered by test/test-media-disc-id.js (13/13). General callback ownership remains pending.
